1.consolidated_definition: Estar en medio de dos partes antagónicas, sin saber qué partido tomar. “Cuando mamá y papá se separaron, todas los hermanos nos sentíamos como el jamón del sandwich.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be caught between two opposing factions, unsure of which side to take. "When my parents got divorced, all of us siblings felt like the ham in a sandwich."
